onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/feel.schema.json, set cf_c_feel to {{cf_c_feel}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera feel preset to {{cf_c_feel}}: snappy=rotationSpeed 15+, smooth=default 8, cinematic=rotationSpeed 3.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/feel.schema.json, set cf_c_collision to {{cf_c_collision}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.enableCollision to {{cf_c_collision}}==on ? true : false.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/feel.schema.json, set cf_t_rotation_speed to {{cf_t_rotation_speed}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.rotationSpeed to {{cf_t_rotation_speed}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/feel.schema.json, set cf_t_translation_speed to {{cf_t_translation_speed}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.translationSpeed to {{cf_t_translation_speed}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/feel.schema.json, set cf_t_sensitivity to {{cf_t_sensitivity}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.mouseSensitivity to {{cf_t_sensitivity}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/feel.schema.json, set cf_t_fov to {{cf_t_fov}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.fieldOfView to {{cf_t_fov}} degrees.
